evidence.reason: The admission marker is created with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, but only the token file descriptor is fsynced. A file fsync does not persist the marker's directory entry, so a power loss after creation can lose the hold and allow admission despite the recorded token. The same durability gap applies to the unlink release path. This is a routine crash-safety correctness defect in the intended admission-hold behavior, not a new requirement.
